verdict.rationale: Sentry has a public pricing page listing plan tiers, such as a Free tier for solo devs with Error Monitoring and Tracing, and plan features like SAML + SCIM, so some pricing is published without contacting sales. The evidence does not show per-signal rates (per error, span, log, or replay), overage costs, or any cost-estimation tooling. missing for 10: published per-signal unit prices, quota/overage pricing details, paid-tier price points, cost calculator or estimation guidance, independent confirmation that costs are predictable without sales.
